description.narrative: Oxfam in Syria will be focusing in providing support to collective shelters established in Aleppo due to the earthquake response through: • Non -Food Item (NFI) distribution (gender sensitive kits) and potentially Multi Purpose Cash (MPC) assistance given that the markets are highly functional in such an urban area like Aleppo city. • Cash for house rental for those households who lost their houses. • Due to collapsed buildings or houses, affected families may not have winter clothing, blankets, shelter tents to protect them from the cold and rainy weather. Oxfam will look at the possible gaps on this and who is responding to these needs. • Hygiene kits including jerry cans for water storage in Internally Displaced Person (IDP) camps – to distribute as soon as possible via Syria Society Social Development (SSSD) as our existing partner and/or with our Fragile States Programmes (FSPs). Altogether conduct assessment while doing distribution to determine further needs, government and humanitarian actors' plans. • In case water networks are disrupted/affected by the collapsed buildings, leakage will likely affect the water pressure. Possible water trucking may be needed to ensure safe chlorinated water as measures against cholera. Water needs may be possible both in neighbourhoods affected and neighbouring areas including collective centres. • Conduct assessment to verify the extent damage of water and sanitation and the risk to cholera for possible contamination of broken or leaking pipes. • Explore possible collaboration work with Local Water Establishment (LWE) for any water intervention – as the most priority given the Cholera risks and escalating needs that may arise.
